name: @keelage/mcp

tools.name: keelage_scan
tools.description: One Robinhood Chain token at the three moments, read from the chain now. The code pass (clean code, not clean, unread): verified source, launcher template, owner privileges, transfer-tax code, honeypot flags. The activity pass (passes, fails, not judged): the code again plus sells clearing, the pool not drained, the deployer share, the holder concentration tier. The size (sized $X, not sized): a share of the pool by tier when the entry test clears, with the one reason when not. verdict.moments carries the three with their reasons; verdict.key keeps the 0.3 word (ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, FAIL, UNVERIFIED), mapped in verdict.keys. Computed under a named, dated ruleset (the optional ruleset argument) and marked beta; the facts are measured and timestamped. Jev probabilities as context when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set. Research only, not financial advice.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).

ruleset.description: Which ruleset the verdict is computed under. A preset name (keelage-default; "default" is short for keelage-default), or { lines: [{ key, value }] } to replace lines of keelage-default. Keys are the ones in keelage_record's rules: top10.conviction, top10.scout, pool.deep, size.poolShare, deployer.max, holders.min, entry.midPump, entry.minVolume24h, entry.minTurnoverOfMcap, entry.deepPoolTurnover, entry.convictionBelowPeak, liquidity.maxDrawdown, base.atBase, base.justOff, base.wellOff, jev.halveBands, sweep.minAgeDays, sweep.minPoolUsd, sweep.minMcapUsd, sweep.maxMcapUsd, size.poolShare.scout, activity.triggerVolume24h, watch.minMcapUsd, watch.sixHourlyMcapUsd, watch.hourlyMcapUsd. The facts never change; only the policy over them does. Omitted: keelage-default.

value.description: A number, or for a band line an array of numbers of the same length as the default.

tools.name: keelage_holders
tools.description: Top wallets for one token with pools, contracts and burn addresses labeled, top-10 share excluding pools and contracts, burn share, and the share held by EIP-7702 smart accounts (how the Robinhood app wallet reads).

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).

smartAccounts.description: Check each listed wallet for EIP-7702 delegation (one RPC call per wallet). Default true.

tools.name: keelage_template
tools.description: Which launcher template a contract came from (Pons, LaunchToken, Doppler, UERC20, tokenized stock, or unregistered), with the template verdict, the ABI privileges and the transfer-tax identifier count read from verified source.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).

tools.name: keelage_record
tools.description: The track record behind the verdicts, cut every day from Keelage's own ledger: every Robinhood Chain pass with its 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day outcome, and every token-day since each token's first pool, re-cut daily on the hosted server into tables by horizon, band, tier, mcap, pool, age, dayOne, claim, jev, xPosts, xTone, kind, repeat, path, derived, lines, ledger, universe, tokenDays, launcher, projectType, regime, sized, holderGrowth, worst, best, one table at a time (table) or all at once, with the day-by-day series (history). No dated studies: the rules ship with their origin and are tested on the live tables. Research, not advice.

table.description: One live table. horizon: The same alerts read 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days later. band: Distance from the 30-day low at alert, in 4 bands. tier: Sizing tier at alert: how concentrated the 10 largest wallets were. mcap: Market cap at alert, in 4 bands. pool: Dollars in the trading pool at alert, in 3 bands. age: Age of the token at alert, in 4 bands. dayOne: Where the price stood 24 hours after the alert, and what the week did from there. claim: Whether the token carried a paid takeover claim at alert. jev: Jev's chance of halving within 7 days, in 5 bands, against what happened. xPosts: How many posts X showed about the token in the 24 hours before the alert. xTone: Whether the X read called the attention organic or a campaign. kind: What kind of alert it was: a new token, one that became eligible, or an upgraded tier. repeat: First alert for the token against a later alert on the same token. path: Hours after the alert (1, 4, 12, 24) from the hourly board rows, and the share gone from the board. derived: Bands cut from the data: quartile cut points per stored fact on the train half, read on train and test, with the single cut the data prefers. lines: Every hand-set rule line that maps to a stored fact, tested: 7-day outcome below and above it, all rows and the test half. ledger: Reconciliation: the publisher's own ledger row count against the rows the store holds in the same window. universe: The field: every token on the chain swept once a day (listed, priced, first seen), its own 7- and 30-day return, our alerted tokens against it, first pools by week. tokenDays: Every token-day since each token's first pool: every rule line tested on it, cut by age, market cap, pool, volume, distance from the low, drawdown, code verdict, and holder growth over the prior and the next 7 days. launcher: Which launcher made the token, against what the pass did next. projectType: What the project is (meme, AI agent, DeFi, utility, RWA, bridged major, unknown), against what the pass did next. regime: Passes before and from 2026-10-06: the old shape against the no-floor sweep. sized: Passes that were sized at the pass against passes that were not. holderGrowth: Holder growth over the 7 days after the pass (the count at the pass against the daily sweep 7 days on), in 4 bands, against the 7-day return. worst: The 8 alerts with the worst 7-day return. best: The 8 alerts with the best 7-day return.

history.description: The daily series instead: one point per UTC day with that day's alert count and its 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day headline stats. Default false.

days.description: With history: how many days back. Default 90.

tools.name: keelage_token
tools.description: Everything Keelage holds on one Robinhood Chain token, as the token page shows it: the launch (creator, factory, template, block and time), today's price, cap, pool, volume and holders, the structural verdict the scan last recorded, every alert raised on it with its 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day outcome, the hourly price series, what X showed by day, and a dated log of what changed. Free, never counted. Hosted server only: the local server has no store and says so.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).

tools.name: keelage_today
tools.description: What Keelage read today on Robinhood Chain, as the Today page shows it: this hour's and today's code passes (clean code / not clean / unread, with the reasons), today's activity passes (passes, with the tier and whether each was sized), today's sized passes, and the watch lines that fired on passed tokens (volume, momentum, price, the 10 largest wallets, original holders). One moment (moment) or all four. Free, never counted. Hosted server only: the local server has no store and says so.

moment.description: One moment only. code: This hour's and today's code passes: every new pool read within the hour. activity: Today's activity passes: tokens judged once they traded like a project. sized: Today's sized passes: the activity passes whose entry test cleared. watch: The watch lines that fired today on passed tokens. Omitted: all four.

instructions: Keelage reads Robinhood Chain tokens from the chain and answers at three moments: the code pass (clean code, not clean, unread), the activity pass (passes, fails, not judged) and the size (sized, not sized), plus a holder map, a launcher template, the published track record, one token's page, what was read today, and, as its own call, what X is saying. Every answer is research only, not financial advice. Unknown facts are null, never zero.
